_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-5.5)**_

I fixed the font-size in `UiCardHeader` in `src/app/shared/components/ui-card/ui-card.ts`. I didn't run the app or Storybook to check it.

`--ui-card-title-size` is already a length, `calc(var(--spacing) * N)`. The old `calc(var(--ui-card-title-size) * 1rem)` multiplied a length by a length, which is invalid CSS, so the font size was dropped. It is now `font-size: var(--ui-card-title-size)`.

If `--spacing` is 0.25rem, the compact variant (`* 2`) gives a 0.5rem title and the default (`* 4`) gives 1rem. 0.5rem is very small, so you may want a larger multiplier for compact. I left the values unchanged.
